InventorySemantics.description:
Source inventory completeness semantics.

complete_board: all postings from the entire board/source.
filtered_feed: subset from a configured filter/category.
search_results: results from a query; absence does not imply closure.

board_id.description: Board or tenant identifier within the provider
board_id.title: Board Id

base_url.description: Base URL or entry endpoint for fetching
base_url.title: Base Url

access_rules.description: Documented access constraints, permitted paths, or rate limits
access_rules.title: Access Rules

request_policy.description: HTTP request policies: headers, parameters, timeout seconds
request_policy.title: Request Policy

enabled.description: Whether this source is currently active (synthetic examples default disabled)
enabled.title: Enabled
